highlight_code_with_pygments: use _highlight to syntax highlight a code string with a given language and pygments options
create_rst_code_directive: create a reStructuredText code directive that renders syntax highlighted code blocks with hl-lines support
include_file_with_code_highlighting: use the Include directive to include an external file and render it as a syntax highlighted code block
register_mcss_code_directives: call register_mcss to register the code, code-block, sourcecode directives and inline code role with docutils
render_inline_code_role: use the inline code role to render syntax highlighted inline code snippets in reStructuredText
